changeSet.author: mhatipog
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION ldes_canonical_fragment_url(input_url text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE AS $function$ SELECT CASE WHEN position('?' in input_url) = 0 THEN input_url ELSE split_part(input_url, '?', 1) || '?' || COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(part, '&' ORDER BY part COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(string_to_array(split_part(input_url, '?', 2), '&')) AS items(part) ), '') END $function$;

changeSet.author: mhatipog
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_pages_canonical_fragment_url ON pages (ldes_canonical_fragment_url(partial_url))

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_pages_canonical_fragment_url
